entries.name: Abel Thorne Valerius
entries.notes: Frost Resonance bloodline; bloodright stripped by King Cassian; seeks to repair the damage caused by the Spire.

entries.name: Elara Sol-Voss
entries.notes: Carries a silver icon of Solis; protective of Abel and emotionally affected by threats to him.

entries.name: Thrum Iron-Marrow
entries.notes: Carries a heavy forge wrench; mechanically minded and prone to irreverent humor.

entries.name: Kaelen Vane-Skar
entries.notes: Amber eyes, scales, war-hammer, Silt Guard heritage; fiercely protective of the group.

entries.name: Vaelin Kael-Thar
entries.notes: Quiet, observant, tactically minded; connected to a shadow faction harmed by House Valerius.

entries.name: Lyra Emerald-Weft
entries.notes: Silver-white hair and emerald eyes; learned High Elven from archival texts and treaties but did not grow up speaking it.

entries.name: Kikiasie
entries.notes: Usually called Kiki; carries the black-scaled archival volume containing crucial coordinates.

entries.name: Queen Althaea
entries.notes: Rules from the Grand Sovereign Palace; distrustful of House Valerius but recognizes Abel's unusual Resonance potential.

entries.name: King Cassian Valerius
entries.notes: Abel's father; responsible for the oppressive policies associated with the Spire.

entries.name: Lady Vivienne Valerius
entries.notes: Maternal lineage recognized by the Kael-Vossen commander.

entries.name: King Aldus Valerius
entries.notes: Abel's grandfather; associated with the original expansion and colonial policies that displaced neighboring civilizations.

entries.name: Malakor
entries.notes: Placed young Abel into alchemical laboratories after his Resonance manifested.

entries.name: Kael-Vossen Vanguard Commander
entries.notes: Holds deep hostility toward House Valerius; recognizes Abel's bloodline and speaks High Elven natively. Name intentionally pending canonical introduction.
